title: DECISION: timestamp coarsening placed in Security Considerations
description: The SHOULD for UI timestamp coarsening (present as hour-granularity or relative, not sub-minute) appears in Security Considerations, not in ReadPosition or Message field definitions. This is the correct placement. Coarsening is a presentation guidance — the underlying UTCDate values retain full precision for protocol purposes, and the spec explicitly says 'coarsening is a presentation concern only'. Putting it in the Security Considerations section ensures it is read by implementers performing a security review, which is the audience that needs to act on it. Placing it in the ReadPosition or Message definitions would conflate display behavior with data-model semantics and could mislead implementers into thinking the stored timestamps must be coarsened at the protocol level, which would break interoperability.
